Different words may (1) ______ the same thing in different languages and this is what is referred to as 'family resemblance.' In other words, languages help us (2) ______ reality and then communicate it to others. There are tens and thousands of languages in the world and all of them help us (3) ______ express ourselves, which in turn, gives meaning to our life. options: meant
meaning
mean
meaningful
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "mean"

Explanation:
☛ Grammatical Context: The sentence "Different words may (1) ______ the same thing..." requires a base verb after the modal verb "may". "Mean" fits perfectly as it is the infinitive form without 'to'.
☛ Tense Consistency: The sentence is in present tense, and "mean" expresses a general truth about language, aligning with the context.
☛ Meaning: "Mean" implies "to signify or represent", which matches the discussion about words across languages. "Meant" (past) or "meaning" (gerund) would disrupt the flow.
☛ Error Avoidance: "Meaningful" (adjective) is incorrect as the blank demands a verb.

Exam Tip: After modal verbs (may, can, must), always use the base form of the verb. Identify the tense and part of speech required in the blank.
